differences.a_observable: Close-up camera framing with a steep angle on the yellow Recurly button.
differences.b_observable: Wider camera framing with a flatter angle, making the Recurly button appear smaller.

differences.a_observable: Pronounced vignette with darker corners and soft shadow falloff.
differences.b_observable: Uniform, flat lighting across the frame with minimal corner falloff.

differences.a_observable: Cooler, blue-tinted shadows on the white surfaces.
differences.b_observable: Neutral grey shadows on the white surfaces.
differences.fix: Apply a cool color cast to the shadows.

differences.a_observable: Deeper shadows and higher contrast on the white keyboard keys.
differences.b_observable: Washed out shadows with lower contrast on the white keys.

differences.a_observable: White surfaces are neutral with cool undertones.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the layout spacing of the tiles to bring them closer together, matching the compact composition of the reference.

differences.a_observable: The camera has a dramatic perspective angle, showing significant depth and tilt on the tiles.

differences.a_observable: Strong vignette with noticeable falloff towards the corners of the frame.

differences.a_observable: Deeper shadows in the crevices between tiles, creating a sense of depth.
differences.b_observable: Brighter shadows, making the tiles look flat and disconnected.

differences.a_observable: Warm, creamy tone on the white tiles.
differences.b_observable: Cool, neutral white color cast across the tiles.
differences.fix: Adjust the white balance to introduce warmer tones.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Match the camera perspective angle and focal length, and add a vignette and contact shadows to restore depth.
